title: Checking the fit of walking shoes

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: These walking shoes feel fine at the toes, but my heels lift when I walk. Should I try a smaller size?
turns.zh: 這雙健走鞋的鞋頭很舒服，但走路時腳跟會抬離鞋底。我該試小一號嗎？

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: First, try threading the laces through the top holes. That holds your heels in place without taking away room at the toes.
turns.zh: 先試著把鞋帶穿過最上面的孔。這樣不會縮小腳趾的空間，又能固定腳跟。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: That helps on level ground. On the shop ramp, my left heel still lifts. My right foot feels fine now.
turns.zh: 在平地上有改善。但走店裡的斜坡時，我的左腳跟還是會抬起來。右腳現在很合適。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: I'll bring the same length in a style with a narrower heel. Keep the shoes you're wearing for comparison. Try both pairs on the ramp, not just on the flat floor.
turns.zh: 我拿另一個款式給你，鞋長相同但後跟較窄。先留著你現在穿的鞋做比較。兩雙都到斜坡上試，不要只在平地上試。

audioScript:
These walking shoes feel fine at the toes, but my heels lift when I walk. Should I try a smaller size?
First, try threading the laces through the top holes. That holds your heels in place without taking away room at the toes.
That helps on level ground. On the shop ramp, my left heel still lifts. My right foot feels fine now.
I'll bring the same length in a style with a narrower heel. Keep the shoes you're wearing for comparison. Try both pairs on the ramp, not just on the flat floor.
